prompt: Write a practical guide for a beginner looking to build a consistent daily reading habit. Cover book selection, schedule management, active note-taking, and long-term motivation.
system_prompt: You are an insightful personal development writer. Provide a structured, engaging, and practical guide around 180-220 tokens. Finish naturally.
expected_aspects: Book selection strategy (start with interest or easy reads)
Schedule management (dedicated daily time window, e.g., 15-20 mins)
